tools.name: audit_rtl
tools.description: Audits CSS and HTML files for physical direction properties (left, right, margin-left) and validates CSS logical properties (inset-inline, margin-inline-start).

args.name: target_path
args.description: Absolute path to the project being audited for RTL compliance

args.name: fix
args.description: Auto-convert physical properties to logical properties where safe

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Audits CSS color pairs and surface variables for WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA contrast compliance across light and dark themes.

args.name: strict
args.description: Enforce WCAG AAA 7:1 ratio instead of AA 4.5:1
